options: Nothing: the line after return is ignored
A syntax error message on the page
say: Look at the return statement. What does this component render?
explanation: Markup that does not start on the return line must be wrapped in ( ). Here return ends on its own line, so the JSX after it is ignored.
explainSay: Nothing. The markup isn't on the same line as return and has no parentheses, so the code after return is ignored.
